verdict: Organic presence is holding; paid channels are dark across all three locations.
narrative: Across Forte Metals, Advance Grinding, and O'Hare Precision, all engagement this period came entirely from Google Business Profile — no paid campaigns ran on Meta or Google Ads at any location. Combined, your three profiles delivered 418 total actions (direction requests, calls, and website clicks) in the last 28 days on zero ad spend. O'Hare Precision was the strongest performer at 214 actions with a 42% week-over-week lift, Forte Metals saw a sharp spike in organic search clicks late in the period, and Advance Grinding's GBP activity softened in the final three days — a trend being monitored. Reactivating paid campaigns is the clear next step to bring in measurable leads and reduce reliance on organic visibility alone.

highlights.phrase: total Google Business Profile actions across all three locations in the last 28 days
GBP actions at O'Hare Precision this period, up 42% vs. the prior 7 days
spike in organic search clicks at Forte Metals over the last 7 days

watch_item.issue: Advance Grinding's GBP activity dropped sharply in the last three days, with near-zero actions recorded — the only active channel at that location.
watch_item.fix: Profile visibility is being reviewed and paid campaign reactivation is being prioritized to stabilize inbound demand.
